title: Noether Energy / Phase-Cell EOS Sector Compatibility Firewall
exact_results: Noether-bound q0 has action type and epsilon_Q=P*omega/q0 has inverse-time type
pure normal phase kinetic branch has w=1 and P/q0=1/2
isotropic null branch has w=1/3 and P/q0=1
homogeneous V=K/2 radiation completion has w=1/3 and P/q0=3/4
homogeneous RF-E5 dust has w=0 and total-energy P/q0=1
RF-F8 phase-cell prefactor slope requirement is 3w-1
constant prefactor gives effective phase-cell w=1/3
nonzero phase current has strictly positive rho+p
metric-proportional potential vacuum lies on the zero-phase-current boundary
